entities.name: PMID:27494828
observations: 2016 study titled “Trichostatin A Inhibits Retinal Pigmented Epithelium Activation in an In Vitro Model of Proliferative Vitreoretinopathy.”

entities.name: Trichostatin A
observations: Broad-spectrum histone deacetylase inhibitor tested at 0.1 μM in the in-vitro RPE activation model.

entities.name: Proliferative vitreoretinopathy
observations: In-vitro RPE activation model used TGFβ2 (10 ng/mL) to induce activation-associated responses.

entities.name: TSA reduces RPE activation
observations: In vitro across ARPE-19, primary porcine RPE, and iPS-derived RPE, 0.1 μM TSA reduced TGFβ2-induced collagen-matrix contraction and RPE migration; wounded iPS-RPE had lower α-SMA, and proliferation decreased.
